header.siteHint: The hosted studio and community gallery

upload.hint: JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or BMP. Drop the whole roll at once, frames are grouped into sets of {n} for animations. Frames are kept for 24 hours and then deleted. Several sets can play in one animation.
upload.done: {n} photo in the library · {width}×{height} | {n} photos in the library · {width}×{height}
upload.expired: The previous session has expired, upload the frames again
upload.dropHere: Drop the scans of your roll here
upload.scansHint: JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or BMP. Drop the scans of the whole roll at once: each scan holds several frames and is cut into single frames before the studio opens. Files are kept for 24 hours and then deleted.
upload.skippedLarge: {n} file skipped: larger than {limitMb} MB and not compressible in the browser | {n} files skipped: larger than {limitMb} MB and not compressible in the browser
upload.allTooLarge: Every file is larger than {limitMb} MB and cannot be compressed in the browser. Export them as JPEG

notice.title: Some files are larger than {limitMb} MB
notice.body: {n} of {total} files are heavier than an Instagram animation needs, the largest is {largestMb} MB. They will be gently downsized to {side} px on the long side and repacked as JPEG; the picture in the animation stays the same.
notice.tiff: TIFF cannot be compressed in the browser: TIFF files above {hardMb} MB are skipped, export them as JPEG.

scanMode.title: Frames on each scan
scanMode.oneHint: Every file is a single frame of the roll
scanMode.twoHint: Every scan holds two frames side by side; they are cut into frames first
scanMode.threeHint: Every scan holds three frames side by side; they are cut into frames first
scanMode.fourHint: Every scan holds a whole shot of four frames; they are cut into frames first

cut.title: Cut the scans into frames
cut.hint: Drag inside the frame to move all cells together, pull a corner or an edge to resize them, drag the strip between two cells to change the gap. All cells share one size, so the frames line up without extra shifts.
cut.canvasLabel: Scan {n}: arrows move the frames by one pixel, Shift by ten
cut.scopeSharedHint: The same cut is applied to every scan, check the others below.
cut.scopeEachHint: Each scan keeps its own frame. Pick a scan below and adjust it.
cut.applyAll: Use this frame for all scans

sets.title: Sets
sets.splitAll: Split the library into sets of {n}
sets.shuffleSimilar: Arrange sets so similar palettes sit together
sets.shuffleContrast: Arrange sets so neighbours differ in palette
sets.groupSimilar: Group frames that look alike into sets of {n}
sets.keepOneShown: At least one set stays in the animation
sets.keepOneRendered: At least one set is rendered

order.title: Order and focus
order.hint: The frames play in this order, the numbers are their places on the roll. Drag a frame or use the arrows on hover. Left to right follows the lenses of the camera, right to left flips the motion. Detection compares parallax between frames.
order.confirmed: Order confirmed · {conf}% confidence | Order confirmed · {conf}% confidence · direction guessed from the first frame
order.looksOrder: Looks like {names} · {conf}% confidence | Looks like {names} · {conf}% confidence · direction guessed
order.lowParallax: Parallax is too small ({px} px), the order could not be detected
order.undetermined: Order not detected: {reason}. Arrange the frames by hand.
order.correctAll: Detect and fix the order in every set
order.corrected: Order corrected to {names} · {conf}% confidence | Order corrected to {names} · {conf}% confidence · direction guessed
order.alternate: Alternate: left to right, right to left…

hint.addFrames: Add frames from a multi-lens camera roll to begin.
hint.markPoint: Click the subject that should stay still on any frame. Drag to adjust, arrows move 1 px, Shift moves 10 px.
hint.markPointInSet: Click the subject that should stay still on a frame of set {set} ({n} / {max}). It is searched in every set.
hint.noOverlap: The frames do not overlap after alignment. Move a point or pick other frames.
hint.ready: Check the preview, adjust the output and press Render MP4.

focus.canvasLabel: Frame {n}, click to set the focus point
focus.searching: Searching for the point on the other frames…
focus.allManual: Every other point is set by hand
focus.showLarge: Show frame {n} large · shown at {zoom}× around the point
focus.foundLow: Point found on {n} frames · {low} with low confidence, check them

adjust.title: Adjust
adjust.hint: Brightness and contrast run from −100 to +100, sharpen in steps like one Photoshop Sharpen pass each. Applied before alignment, identically in the browser and on the server. Double-click a slider to reset it. The switch and the shared sliders are remembered for each set.
adjust.perFrameHint: Brightness and contrast are set for each frame under its picture; sharpen applies to the whole set.
adjust.uneven: Frames {frames} differ in exposure from the rest.
adjust.balancedHint: Each frame is balanced automatically; brightness and contrast here apply on top of the balance to the whole set.

output.patternHint: Frame numbers 1–{max} separated by dashes, commas or spaces. Repeats hold a frame longer.

setModes.sweep: One strip: the loop runs through all sets and back

output.sharedFocusHint: On: the focus object stays in the same place in every set, the background may jump between sets. Off: each set is aligned on its own and the framing stays as shot, so the object may move between sets while the background stays.

compositions.mosaic: Mosaic: all sets in a grid

output.parallaxZoomHint: The frame grows slightly with the lens position, from 0% on the first frame to the chosen value on the last, scaled about the focus point. Adds depth to the wiggle.
output.fileHint: Frame rate, length and size of the MP4. With exact repeats the length follows from the sequence.

preview.label: Preview, drag to move the crop frame
preview.needPoints: Mark the point on every frame ({n} / {max})
preview.noOverlap: Frames do not overlap, check the points
preview.info: Common area {area} px · crop {crop} → output {out} · {frames} frames, {seconds} s
preview.customHint: Drag the frame, pull a corner to resize

render.activeSetHint: Render an MP4 of set {n} alone with its own loop

reset.confirm: Clear all frames, points, settings and results in the studio? Uploaded files stay on the server for 24 hours.

layout.title: Roll layout
layout.hint: Frames in the order of the roll, the bar below shows the set. Click a frame to open its set, click a free frame to add it to the current set. Scissors start a new set at that frame and rebuild the sets of four after it. Escape closes.
layout.hintSets: Each block is one set of {n}. The set name opens it; click a frame to move it into the current set or out of it, click a free frame to add it.

outputMode.label: What to make
outputMode.combinedHint: Every shown set goes into one MP4
outputMode.separateHint: A separate MP4 for each shown set: {n} videos in one archive

outputChoice.title: The roll has {n} sets. What should they become?
outputChoice.combinedHint: Sets play one after another in a single MP4, with a shared composition
outputChoice.separate: A separate MP4 for each set
outputChoice.separateHint: {n} videos with the same settings, downloaded as one archive
outputChoice.later: You can switch this any time above the frames.

batch.done: Done: {n} MP4, download them as one archive
batch.doneWithFailures: Done: {n} MP4, {failed} failed, hover a set to see why
batch.failed: The batch stopped with an error, {n} MP4 are ready
batch.noOverlap: Frames of set {set} do not overlap, check its points

timeline.title: Timeline

presets.swing: Swing: long on the first set

timeline.cyclesTitle: Plays {n} times in a row, click to change

loop.title: Loop
loop.hint: How the {n} frames of the set play and how many times in a row. Ping-pong loops without a jump, ends give the strongest parallax, middle the softest. The same is editable right on the clip in the timeline: drag frames, click the loop sign or ×N.
loop.sweepNote: In “One strip” the loop runs through all sets, loops and repeats of single sets do not apply.
loop.syncedNote: In simultaneous compositions every set plays the loop of the first set.

composition.title: Composition
composition.hint: How several sets are combined into one video and a little depth on top. Crossfade blends frames at the seams of sets; double exposure, split frame, mosaic and triptych play all sets at once.

setSize.title: Photos in a set
setSize.hint: Every animation is built from {n} photos taken at once: pick the number of lenses of your camera

render.validation_failed: The server rejected the request. It may be running an older version, restart it with the current code

upload.library_full: The library holds at most {limit} frames
upload.disk_full: The server is out of space, try again later

session.not_found: The session has expired, upload the frames again

frame.indices_out_of_range: Some frames are missing from the session

render.no_overlap: Frames do not overlap after alignment, check the focus points
render.common_area_too_small: The common area is too small for this format
render.pattern_required: Enter a frame pattern for the custom loop
render.encode_failed: Video encoding failed on the server
render.too_large: Too many frames for this size: {frames} × {width}×{height}. Lower the width or the number of sets
render.split_too_small: The frames would be too small, enlarge the frame or reduce the gap

video.not_found: The video has not been rendered yet

batch.not_found: The batch was not found, it may have expired
batch.not_ready: The batch has no finished videos yet
